entry_guard_liquidation_quote_proxy: OPEN minus side*0.25, exactly analogous to native bid for LONG / ask for SHORT. If this is at/beyond fixed stop, consume/cancel pending entry and record exclusion. No filled trade.
actual_entry_quote_proxy: OPEN plus side*0.25; separate from liquidation-side guard.
completed_features: Only 5min bars with end<=currentsecondSTART. The bar ending exactly at decisionsecondEND is committed after feature observation, first used as completed feature in next second.
current_forming_stop_and_BB: May include currentsecondOHLC at its END, when it is known. No earlier intrasecond decision/fill is claimed.
path_consensus: Every reachable prior state and both OHLC scenarios must each contain exactly one return of same side in same second; otherwise no candidate and ambiguity retained.
